subject: Vulnerability management evidence: cadence alignment & closure playbook
messages:
From: Natalie Park <natalie.park@northbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: security-requests@northbridge.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM evidence and cadence for SOC2/SIG review

Hi Olga,

We're preparing for our SIG/SOC2 evidence collection this month and need consolidated vulnerability management artifacts from Redwood for our external audit. Can you provide the following by EOD Tue Sep 15?

- Current scan cadence (authenticated vs unauthenticated, scope: infra/services) and when the last full authenticated scan ran.
- SLA commitments for CVE remediation by severity (Critical / High / Medium / Low) and any exception handling/expedited processes.
- Proof of recent remediation: list of CVEs closed in the last 90 days with short notes (affected component, patch applied, date).
- An executive attestation confirming your cadence & SLA statements for audit purposes.

Preferred formats: PDF for attestation, CSV for patch manifest, and a brief diagram of cadence. If you already have a single evidence packet or Drive folder, sending that link is fine.

We may need a one-hour walkthrough afterward — please include a couple of 30–60 minute windows next week.

Thanks,
Natalie Park
Senior InfoSec Program Manager
Northbridge Bank
security-requests@northbridge.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Park <natalie.park@northbridge.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence and cadence for SOC2/SIG review

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a consolidated packet ahead of your deadline. Summary below, full artifacts attached/linked.

Quick summary (short answers):
- Scan cadence: weekly unauthenticated scans across all prod+staging. Authenticated scans (credentialed) run every 14 days against production services and critical infra. Container images scanned on build (CI) with daily image-repo scans. Last full authenticated prod scan completed: 2026-09-07.
- SLA commitments: Critical CVE (CVSS 9.0+ or exploit in wild): 7 days to mitigation or mitigations-in-place + 30-day remediation plan; High: 30 days; Medium: 90 days; Low: tracked in backlog with quarterly remediation. Emergency triage and hotpatch lane exists for critical/high with a dedicated on-call rotation.
- Remediation proof (last 90 days): attached CSV (patch-manifest-20260910.csv) lists CVE IDs, component, remediation type, PR/CL link, and closed date.
- Executive attestation: we are providing a signed attestation PDF (vm-closure-commitment.pdf).

Attachments in this email: vm-closure-commitment.pdf (attestation), patch-manifest-20260910.csv (manifest), scan-cadence-diagram.png (cadence flow + roles). We also created a Drive folder and DocuSign envelope for formalities — links below.

Proposed next steps and availability:
- We will upload the packet to the Drive folder by 2026-09-10 18:00 PDT.
- Proposed walkthrough slots: Sep 14 09:00–10:00 PDT or Sep 14 14:00–15:00 PDT. If those don't work, happy to accommodate.

I pulled Laura (Head of Security Operations) and Ben (Solutions) on cc to confirm the SLA wording and provide the attestation.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Security Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
attachments: [vm-closure-commitment.pdf, patch-manifest-20260910.csv, scan-cadence-diagram.png]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Park <natalie.park@northbridge.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence and cadence for SOC2/SIG review

Natalie / Olga —

Confirming the SLA commitments below and adding an executive attestation for audit use. As Head of Security Operations I attest that Redwood Inference maintains the scan cadence and remediation timelines described by Olga. Where exceptions occur, we route through our escalation matrix with documented compensating controls and a formal exception approval logged in our risk register.

To be explicit:
- Critical: 7-day mitigation or documented workaround + 30-day remediation plan; emergency patch window and hotpatch verification required.
- High: 30 days to remediation; tracking and escalation for no-progress items at 14 days.
- Medium: 90 days; exceptions recorded and prioritized against risk.
- Low: reviewed quarterly and scheduled.

The attached PDF (vm-closure-commitment.pdf) is a signed attestation. If audit needs a notarized or countersigned letter, let us know the exact wording and we will route it.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Natalie Park <natalie.park@northbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: security-requests@northbridge.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence and cadence for SOC2/SIG review

Thanks, Olga and Laura — this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick clarifications before we close the packet: 

1) Can you confirm the manifest includes links to PRs/patches or CVE ticket numbers that our auditors can sample?
2) For Critical CVEs that were mitigated within 7 days — can you provide the verification steps (smoke tests or post-patch scans) taken and evidence output for one sample? A screenshot or log excerpt is fine.

If you can drop those two items into the Drive folder today, we can mark the evidence packet as complete. Also the Sep 14 14:00–15:00 PDT slot works for our team for a walkthrough.

Best,
Natalie
